title: What the Tasmanian Devil bites

is_this_you.pressure: Push you and you scream first. The noise is the warning. Most people never meet the bite.
is_this_you.love: You let one or two into the den. After that you would chew through bone for them.
is_this_you.cost: The bite that keeps you alive is the same one that hurts you. You still lead with it.

opener.text: A man was buried at Lake Nitchie about 6,820 years ago [wentworth]. Around his neck hung 178 pierced devil teeth [wentworth]. That is teeth from about 49 animals [wiki-td]. Somebody hunted devils for those teeth [wiki-td]. Somebody wore it into the ground. You were born a Scorpio in a Dog year. You know what it is to wear your teeth where people can see them.

tabs.label: The scream
tabs.intro: Water behind a stone wall. Loud at the gate.

rows.text: Scorpio is fixed Water [wiki-sco]. Deep, determined, loyal once trust is earned [mbg-sco]. The Dog is yang Earth [wiki-dog]. Candid, upright, wary of strangers [tcg-dog]. Earth holds Water. So your feelings have walls. Your ground is small, and every inch of it is defended.

Settlers heard screams, coughs and growls in the night bush [nre-faq]. At a carcass those sounds are mostly bluff, a ritual that keeps real fighting down [nre-about]. Your yelling works the same way. It settles who gets what. Then everybody eats.

No living mammal carnivore bites harder for its size [wiki-td]. Of a small carcass a devil can leave nothing, bones and fur included [wiki-td]. You eat the whole job. Nobody comes back to tidy up after you.

tabs.label: What you will not let go
tabs.intro: The grip is the gift. It is also the wound.

rows.text: Devil facial tumour disease passes mostly through bites [wiki-dftd]. Devil numbers fell about 80 percent in two decades [wiki-dftd]. The thing the devil does best is how it gets hurt. You know that shape.
Scorpio holds grudges [mbg-sco]. The Dog bottles up stress [tcg-dog]. Put them together and an old hurt can sit in your jaw for years. Spit it out while it is still small.
Emergency wards and salvage yards both need someone who stays until nothing is left undone. Send yourself where other people flinch.

tabs.label: Who can take your bite
tabs.intro: Three who hear the snarl and stay. One who bites back.
tabs.love_lead: In love you are slow to open the den, then all in. Scorpio feels more than it says, and the Dog values loyalty over romance [mbg-sco] [tcg-dog]. Pick someone who hears your scream as bluff and keeps eating beside you. The old pairings give you three.

easy.why: The Pallas's Cat (Scorpio, Rabbit year) is your secret friend, since the Rabbit is the Dog's hidden ally, and it shares your Scorpio sun [wiki-cz] [wiki-sco].
The Orca (Scorpio, Horse year) stands in your trine of Tiger, Horse and Dog, under the same sign [wiki-cz] [wiki-sco].
The Moon Bear (Cancer, Tiger year) carries the Tiger of your trine, and Cancer is Water like you [wiki-cz] [wiki-sco].

hard.why: The hard one is the Gila Monster (Scorpio, Dragon year): the Dragon clashes with the Dog, so two Scorpio jaws lock onto each other [wiki-cz] [wiki-sco].

story.text: The palawa kani name is purinina [wiki-td]. Older records give tarrabah and poirinnah [wiki-td]. Then settlers heard the screams in the dark, and some thought of hellhounds [nre-faq]. The name devil stuck [nre-faq].

closing: Keep your teeth. Somebody once thought them worth wearing into the grave.
